SELECT tsc.train_id AS trainId, sc.type AS seatType, tsc.carriage_number AS carriageNumber, s.seat_no AS seatNo, sio.start_sequence, sio.end_sequence, CONCAT(tsc.train_id, '_', sc.type, '_', tsc.carriage_number, '_', s.seat_no) AS unique_key FROM seat_class sc INNER JOIN train_seat_class tsc ON sc.id = tsc.seat_class_id INNER JOIN seat s ON tsc.id = s.train_seat_class_id LEFT JOIN seat_interval_occupy sio ON s.id = sio.seat_id AND sio.status IN (1, 2) -- 仅查有效占用区间（1=锁定中，2=已售出） AND (sio.expire_time IS NULL OR sio.expire_time > NOW()) -- 未过期 AND (sio.start_sequence < sio.end_sequence)
(tsc.train_id, sc.type, tsc.carriage_number, s.seat_no) IN
(#{item.trainId}, #{item.seatType}, #{item.carriageNumber}, #{item.seatNo})
ORDER BY FIELD( unique_key,
CONCAT(#{item.trainId}, '_', #{item.seatType}, '_', #{item.carriageNumber}, '_', #{item.seatNo})
), tsc.carriage_number, s.seat_no, sio.start_sequence
ORDER BY tsc.carriage_number, s.seat_no, sio.start_sequence

SELECT sio.id, sio.seat_id, tsc.train_id, sio.start_sequence, sio.end_sequence, sio.order_id, sio.order_type, sio.status, sio.create_time, sio.expire_time FROM seat_interval_occupy sio INNER JOIN seat s ON s.id = sio.seat_id INNER JOIN train_seat_class tsc ON tsc.id = s.train_seat_class_id WHERE -- 过滤有效状态：锁定中/已售出 sio.status IN (0, 1) -- 过滤过期 AND ( (sio.status = 1 AND sio.expire_time IS NULL) OR (sio.status = 0 AND sio.expire_time > NOW()) ) -- 过滤非法区间 AND sio.start_sequence < sio.end_sequence
